title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.16
subtitle: Attachments that follow your animated character.

highlights.title: Attach to Collider surfaces
highlights.description: Attach Cloth or Soft Body to static, moving and deforming Collider targets using the existing Attachment editor or vertex groups. Requires Gaia 0.23 and stable surface topology.

highlights.title: Deformation-aware anchors
highlights.description: Anchors follow evaluated armature and shape-key deformation while preserving their vertex indices and weights. Bake validation restores your timeline position.
